title: Pig holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- balloon string -->
  <path d='M72 38 Q70 52 62 62' stroke='#E8E8F0' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none'/>
  <!-- balloon -->
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='26' rx='11' ry='13' fill='#FF4D6D'/>
  <ellipse cx='68' cy='21' rx='3' ry='4' fill='#FF9FB2'/>
  <polygon points='72,39 69,43 75,43' fill='#D63A58'/>
  <!-- pig body -->
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='70' rx='24' ry='18' fill='#FF9EC4'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='28' y='82' width='8' height='10' rx='3' fill='#E87AA8'/>
  <rect x='52' y='82' width='8' height='10' rx='3' fill='#E87AA8'/>
  <!-- arm holding balloon -->
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='60' rx='6' ry='9' fill='#FF9EC4' transform='rotate(35 66 60)'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='45' r='20' fill='#FF9EC4'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <polygon points='28,32 34,18 42,28' fill='#E87AA8'/>
  <polygon points='60,32 54,18 46,28' fill='#E87AA8'/>
  <polygon points='32,30 35,23 39,29' fill='#FFC4DA'/>
  <polygon points='56,30 53,23 49,29' fill='#FFC4DA'/>
  <!-- snout -->
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='52' rx='10' ry='7' fill='#FF85B3'/>
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='52' rx='2' ry='2.5' fill='#C95A82'/>
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='52' rx='2' ry='2.5' fill='#C95A82'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='37' cy='42' r='2.8' fill='#3A1030'/>
  <circle cx='51' cy='42' r='2.8' fill='#3A1030'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='41' r='1' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='41' r='1' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='31' cy='50' r='3' fill='#FF6FA0'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='50' r='3' fill='#FF6FA0'/>
</svg>
